name: Hook templates + publish dashboard
goal: Improve hook quality with proven viral templates and give operators a publish history dashboard panel

tasks.title: Hook template library for ScriptAgent
tasks.description: Add HOOK_TEMPLATES constant to agents/scs001-script/index.ts — 20+ proven TikTok hook templates across 5 formula types. ScriptAgent.buildBundle() selects a template matching the hook formula and wraps the insight text in it. Falls back to raw hook text if formula has no template.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: HOOK_TEMPLATES has >= 20 entries across >= 4 formula types. buildBundle uses template when formula matches. Original text used as fallback. Smoke test passes.
tasks.context: ScriptAgent is 157 lines. Hook formula comes from InsightBrief.hook.formula. Existing formulas: curiosity_gap, secret, contrarian, statistic, challenge, authority. hook.text contains raw insight text.

tasks.title: Publish ledger dashboard parser
tasks.description: Create dashboard/parsers/publish_ledger.py. Functions: get_publish_history(limit=50) reads workspace/scs001/publish-ledger.jsonl, returns last N entries sorted desc. get_publish_stats() returns total_published, runs_count, latest_run_id, latest_published_at. Handle missing file gracefully.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: get_publish_history returns list of dicts. get_publish_stats returns correct totals. Handles missing file gracefully.
tasks.context: Ledger has 63 entries with fields: clip_id, video_id, published_at, run_id. 5 unique run_ids. Follow pattern in dashboard/parsers/pipeline.py.

tasks.title: Publish ledger API endpoints
tasks.description: Add to dashboard/server.py: import get_publish_history + get_publish_stats from parsers.publish_ledger. Add GET /api/publish/history and GET /api/publish/stats endpoints.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: /api/publish/history returns JSON array. /api/publish/stats returns JSON object with total_published, runs_count. Server starts without errors.
tasks.context: server.py is 530 lines. Follow pattern of existing pipeline endpoints.

tasks.title: Dashboard Panel 15 — Publish History
tasks.description: Add Panel 15 to dashboard/static/app.js after Panel 14 (renderReadiness). Shows stats header from /api/publish/stats and scrollable table of last 50 videos from /api/publish/history. Register renderPublishHistory in ALL_RENDERERS.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Panel 15 renders with title 'Publish History'. Shows stats and table. No JS errors. Existing panels unaffected.
tasks.context: app.js is 1377 lines with 14 panels. ALL_RENDERERS array at the bottom. Panel 14 is renderReadiness. Write directly — file too large for swarm.
